notes.title: Living in a Brothel v0.4.1 released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/654e6bb360cb05175013025f3813304bf7e9a283.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/d72d8b30a7cb57626365d32f4d77a1b4510f21a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9be3b472106b538f8a3907b156f2235510a2384e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/326e736d6c38d10ce550984de95e62f047fe18f3.png[/img]
What's up, guys!
We’re thrilled to announce that Living in a Brothel version 0.4.1 is officially here!
This update brings a mix of fresh content, polish, and that special flair you’ve come to love.

You may find it weird that the title says v0.4.1 and not v0.4.0, but that's exactly what it is.
During the testing phase, we discovered some bugs and took the opportunity to fix them before launching on Steam.
This version, with the bugs fixed, was called v0.4.1.

Without further ado, here’s what’s new:
[h2]============//============[/h2]
[h1]Version 0.4.1:[/h1]
[h3]Fucking Your Customer Scene Remake:[/h3]

Fixed an issue where the main character had female nails in some parts of this scene.
To do this, we needed to redo several renders and animations:
[list]
[*] 19 Renders Remade
[*] 7 Animations Remade
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[b]Gamepad A Button Update:[/b] The gamepad A button now functions similarly to the left mouse button instead of the Enter button as it did previously.
This allows you to drag and collect Secret Cards from posters. (Steam Version Only)

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed a bug where clicking on some Gallery Image thumbnails in the menu would incorrectly display a different Gallery Image than the one selected.
[h2]============//============[/h2]
[h1]Version 0.4.0:[/h1]
[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 283 New Renders
[*] 61 New Animations
[*] 7 New Gallery Images
[*] 7 New Scenes
[*] 5 New Songs
[*] 2 New Achievements
[*] 2 Gallery Images were turned into animations
[/list]
[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[b]Exploring the City:[/b] Now the player will be able to access other parts of the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door.
For now, the only accessible location is the gym, but in the future, more locations in the city will be accessible as the story progresses.

[b]Steam Cloud Support:[/b] Added support for the Steam Cloud feature.
You can now share your save between different devices when playing the Steam version, as well as keep a backup of your save in the cloud.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[b]Monochromatic Effect:[/b] The code related to the monochromatic effect, which is used in character memories, has been optimized.
It's now possible to use this effect in animations.

[b]Updated Achievements Requirements:[/b] The requirements for unlock the achievements listed in the Achievement Menu have been updated to include the new content in this version.
Players will need to complete the requirements related to the new content in order to unlock achievements that were previously present in the game.

[b]Automatic New Clothes:[/b] The code related to the implementation of renders that change the character's outfit depending on the day the game is in has been optimized.
Now, new outfits that appears in future updates will be included automatically, without the need for changes to the code.

[b]Way to unlock Gallery Images updated:[/b] 13 Gallery Images that were previously automatically unlocked in bulk are now unlocked via Secret Cards or through the main storyline, one by one.

[b]Jackpot Animation:[/b] When you hit a Jackpot in the Slot Machine Minigame, an animation is played along with the previously existing sound effect from now on.

[b]Performance Boost:[/b] We have optimized the use of cache memory and RAM, ensuring a significant performance gain. On the other hand, the game's RAM usage has increased and, consequently, the required specifications.
This has resulted in faster loading of game files, which can be especially noticeable in animations, which now run smoothly. You'll also notice that the game will respond more quickly to your inputs from now on.

[h3]Adjustments:[/h3]

[b]Committed Reader Achievement:[/b] We've reduced the percentage of script that must be read to unlock this achievement from 95% to 90%.
This achievement was harder to unlock than we planned, so we've adjusted the requirements to make it easier for players to reach.

[b]Diagonal Jackpots:[/b] From now on, when you manage to line up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" diagonally in the Slot Machine Minigame, it'll count as a Jackpot.
We initially decided to only count a Jackpot when you lined up 3 "7s" or 3 "BARs" in the center, as we wanted this to be a hard achievement to unlock, but we felt that the difficulty was higher than we had planned.
This change should make it easier to unlock the Jackpot achievement, while still keeping it sufficiently challenging.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed a bug where "The Curious Girl" scene was unlocked in the Replay section before being completed during gameplay.

Fixed a bug where, in specific situations, character icons would not load during mobile conversations, messing up the layout, and consequently, it was not possible to read them properly.
[h2]============//============[/h2]
A huge thank you to our amazing community for your support so far – you’re the reason we keep pushing Living in a Brothel forward. If you haven’t already, hop into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9wnXg9vqA4]Discord server[/url] to share your thoughts, report bugs, or just chat.
Time to head back to the brothel and see what version 0.4.1 has in store for you.
Cheers! 🍻

notes.title: Progress Report - 2nd Semester 2024
notes.content:
What's up, guys!
It's been a while since the last news published here regarding the progress in the development of Episode 4.
We're completely focused on the development itself, as we want to deliver the next update to you as soon as possible, and we're very close to that, but while the update does not come, we decided to bring you one more piece of news.

Despite the apparent hiatus, we've been actively developing the project, so we'll take advantage of this news to update you on everything we've progressed so far.
There has been progress in several areas of the game, so to make it easier to understand, we'll separate them by topic.

[h2]The first update after the latest news[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/db693041622b3256fc91acac0779ef0ad47b7712.png[/img]
It's nothing extraordinary, it's just some renders that are part of a small dialogue that ends the interaction with Sakura, right after her masturbation scene.
In this dialogue, you give her the TV remote, fulfilling her request, as she needs to replace the TV remote in Beatrice's room with the new one you just bought at the shop, as the one in Beatrice's room is defective.
This has a context in the events that happen on the 5th day, you'll understand better when you play.

With these renders and the dialogue that has also been written and inserted into the game, we have definitively completed the interaction with Sakura.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/ae685adfdfb7bcea40cd3a9c25faf1ef6e18c7c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/24fcdf462543965b1ad72822461cbf4e3c34fce9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/ca9e21a7b65218cf45b374008c2a065ef83c3ff4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/af84d9555ef354d0128b59c845de2e5676d5b734.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9bb3cd64b08049657333da122fe368dd5646d65a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a37a2907bc9361ed7008d005e2256f7d68731b7c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/0c33760256d82f07593baddfd9094b226142315a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/504b359d9eea1218584fdfde6ca9f44b30d64316.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/43123c2fcb01af95651386a13724d2f85a5c1773.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/09a66fc16d97e2bab5e92f6c8adb715cc8596a29.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/569da9383b37e1c60418dfc93008563b9ec419fd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8c56337bd21b6dda13c34fe26700a148b0dc450b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3fa95d9c801ed3bf5250209ab339db44e7601fd1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/180fbfc791aab3d25260d210f661373b6677bd4d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a9446677fc8923f4db4a110b398579141a8326e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4f7819c53e1e4006df70dcf5b95a212b8188d623.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Interaction with Julia - First Part[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/1d465efce7184311025256f44ee7eab49caebc09.png[/img]
We have the first part of the dialogue with Julia!
As mentioned at the end of episode 3, the main focus of episode 4 is Julia, and now we can say that we're finally getting into that.

The entire dialogue between Julia and MC has already been written and the renders are also done. These renders attached to the topic make up the first part of the dialogue.
The second part will involve Beatrice, Julia and MC, and we'll see it in the next topic.

As you can see in the first image (cover) attached to this topic, we'll be able to visit the gym again.
Starting in Episode 4, the player will be able to access other parts of the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door, the one where you hang the sign in Episode 1.

At first, the only accessible place will be the gym, but in the future, a menu will be added that will allow access to new locations in the city that will appear as the story progresses.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/7e0d0e5e12ccd623936129d1b300403349660e16.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/37da5ac2f1efd3f973364da7c2c0ef4870037644.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8cab397219ca50d23391b98a9556318f9cc0cd8b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3126d13ed05a1bdd9ac155f1f6bfb2dbbd0527cc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/5106cb6cd91c0ed0fce496f3db53583a6280ef71.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/da46c62d53cc7aba13b96f4c0c4032f5daa55be2.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4ac1f776e12881aa2b983847c47baedd0a53d98d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9f72e7397e23b159d7eb9f90cc51c4ea751d2801.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/60c65cec232bec016978572bbb34429639bd74a9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/edd8ca2f71996cb2967344fa841c3511f2a5f81a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/ae43be12a1299628fcfd4b09ef79461f8ed6c95e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/384661f83f75f80e440a3f5dffc80d2682c326ab.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a21b549a96e7b50a4003e52386bd20b5e64044a6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/525a0e60778dfb8faa669a2584953ac1e0ca4d73.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Pole Dancer Scene Completed[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/46692fd446049cf6b6eb31b0d7fa969708cb9348.png[/img]
This was the most laborious scene, due to it being the scene related to Exploration Mode in this episode.

Let's talk a little more about the context of the images attached to this topic:

The first image (cover) was attached to the topic to show the 3 scenes we already have done, among them, the "The Pole Dancer" scene, which is the one we mentioned in this topic.
The other 2 refer to the sex scenes that we have already published in previous news.
In fact, this will be a pro of this version, it'll be full of sex scenes, with characters not yet explored in previous versions.

As for the other images, they make up the second (and final) part of the interactions with Julia, which is when she goes to Beatrice to talk to her and agrees to become one of the girls in the brothel.
We won't give any more details about this so as not to give spoilers, but you can see some images that make up the scene, including some expressions.
In our opinion, Julia looked really cute in some expressions like smiling and thinking.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/7dfc9213fdbf7edae83af3db1e5a5626f3bbf0c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a2682e0e2aa3ba39b314569e0c46931962658d29.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/6dcf5e7627f531ae5643adb78fe053ebf665eec5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3e797021de2fa480a3f5bc5a74116706895d3136.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/68855f91cc3242b5ee5cd789656a2371028fc222.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/05fcb14cb06dde6b2da8983ea40837c88d2a5342.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/bf316b9f243a2ca0f66ca75813946ab805b47841.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/b9d9565859a6d16f5fde3be8fb80da5160c65967.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/18031bf4860ae3dbce72968393d6fa3e62d8301a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/6cc7dec2e3b0d28bffb9921e54e07f06ad0bdea6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/5f0677734570154e8a7f43b786e22ebb3b40864e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/538f59cd28cda3fb5debcfddf5b2fc68a979a15b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/32b5974174031c3bd5792278af3fcf9a2c46821a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/190c61f26401689b6030959264311bc77e2192de.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/dbb49384c8eb0bc1be1826b2327deed5eb720d6e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/fc3ab69414b5615a7330b21716b165f982ddce94.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/976304b5fa2e900370a1ccd012d37aa9c7a94ad8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3ece74b3367b5b30ca727a38b65123c19f18a68a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Philip, The First Customer of the 5th Day[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/ada042ffb1d4e89ce1c789d8cccc4ab1febbf638.png[/img]
After we complete The Pole Dancer scene, we finally started working on the bar scene for episode 4.
As usual, every episode you can play the "Being the Bartender" minigame and each day you have different customers who order different drinks.
The first customer of day 5 is Philip, the character shown in the preview images attached to this topic.

As you can see, there are different emotions for this character present in the images that will make up the dialogue between him and the MC.
Luna can also be seen in the background of the scene serving customers wearing her famous purple lingerie.
All the dialogue has already been completely written and the renders that make up this scene are also done.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/64e0412547a54419be0da6084485e4e6386afaf3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/949beb6cdf3fbe453209f2d33d058b0ffdccc559.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/60fb194a935a1145ede0a323bd1ece9baafb25c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/c23425dad171310ce0f43047b787b14ad53d8bb9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/5b9087c3a94e6c12d4035ffa139fe73e5f24ff56.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/48a6df49b2dc792f9aeb793f7ae05412293e6d32.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/581f2130526b083063b5e370a063da7431ff5a64.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/113426230b8adc4e336c5a14a858cf239f1ccd5b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a18cf8b76b5d344e9b725f8948d734fa74bb0b55.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9be41025d6023fe35bd76243bfa487de4a215937.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/71cf242dc5f62f8701d2a10ea3a36854f2428f2b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/c6d17beb36b485c278a8fc1f01d8011829cbbe6a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3ba846aa042cfe188c8dc9800ad6b52b996ab102.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/36a1ff3c0a17670fae4ad7e4da73b49db6b4cd36.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/46d8da719f06d9d1bd557882eb529b3e56ff3577.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/588135f24f471adcb1a39be9a4a3ffa388aedece.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Leon, The Second Customer of the 5th Day[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/f5a81016c7b23ca995c28cda349c27dabc6e1260.png[/img]
This topic is about the second customer of day 5: Leon.
Unlike the customer shown in the previous topic, this one will have an impact on the main story, as he'll be responsible for helping to promote the brothel and make it more popular.
Starting from the next episode, the brothel will be more crowded than usual.
With that, we've completed the entire customers part of Day 5.

Leon's part is totally done, both the renders and the dialogue.
There's also a small part where Luna will come to tell the main character that he's being called to one of the 2nd floor rooms, which we'll not reveal for now so as not to give spoilers.
As for this small part, it's also done, so we can consider that the entire dialogue part is finished.

As for the preview images attached to this topic, let's go step by step:
In images 1 (cover) to 5, we have several expressions from Leon that make up the dialogue between him and the main character.
In images 6 to 8, we have him drinking the drink that you'll have to serve him in this episode.
In images 9 and 10, we see him taking a drag during his dialogue with the MC.

Although Leon is the main focus of these images, you'll notice that Veronika is also seen serving drinks in the background.
There is a specific order to these images that "tell the story" of her serving drinks and collecting the empty glasses that customers have already consumed.
This order was not respected in the preview images posted here, but they'll be properly sequenced ingame.
This was a small detail that we made sure to have in this part of the development, as we wanted both Luna and Veronika to appear parading in lingerie in the background, as we had not explored this outfit on the characters in this context previously.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/57eb3e52195ef8a31dd8890c0fa7f161600dd1f6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3227a076d4e32f668599f316c4dd6f857bd28bcd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/0a8a4c2becf0021fc75e9580f26b8e60a4f10d6e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4920686e42d27ec6c643995b84eb4377939511cd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/7edb7bc6764709f90257bfff952a3d2df96a8193.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/893bcb9dbfc7a1fa5089088ffe029a4f412bf359.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9758692cb5a51cf29208442bee9f96b89c0d037b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/2b6219ee013ba2037053606da905a87457751882.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/7a611e63066fd73f1a9237a1c711a3348771b3ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/bbd21f9dc7207a5ae887dafebbea742e4912ce0a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/59c6ebd1eda1faca42dd2581c44d9e6aec889574.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/caceece33b82f4a2d7b68839bfb1cd24b3963ff7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/98494b9d507d14f14c671985d2f2012ca6ad7b8f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/689b10bcc53555ae00c426eade38c3bd0b42bd35.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9c31102bce0dd60c670054eda63f3e94109ca8ea.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4e99d27e4e5533f94569d807c6f28ddc8ffd01b1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/d240cffaec9764797384625c84b8b19b10c6d0ef.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3bbe9209d50bb5752b0b64fb611963dee89775a1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Julia Pole Dance Scene - Animation[/h2]
[previewyoutube=O_zuGhCF_Ug;full][/previewyoutube]
This news highlight surely is the preview video attached to this topic, which shows the final result of this animation.

This is the most complex animation we've worked on so far, with 588 different frames in a single animation. It's a lot of work, but we decided to go all out on this animation because it's the main theme of this episode, so we want it to be really well done.
We had to pose frame by frame, adjusting every detail of the character's body, such as posing each limb, each finger, etc. In addition, we had to make the pose so that there is continuity compared to the previous frames, so that the animation is fluid.
It's quite an achievement, so we hope you enjoy the final result, which you can see in the preview video attached to this topic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/cfb38bd2474e7889a9e6821629c512ba59552848.png[/img]
This animation will also have a nude variant that will be part of the same scene. Initially, she was going to dance just wearing the bikini, but we thought players would want to see Julia dancing completely naked, so we decided to include this second version as an extension of the scene.
The nude variant has also had its posing process completed.
This animation is currently in the rendering process.
It'll be posted here at the next opportunity, as it should be finished by then.

We created a script for what will happen during this scene:
[olist]
[*] She'll walk down the catwalk wearing the bikini.
[*] She'll do the Pole Dance wearing the bikini.
[*] There'll be a pause and she'll take off her clothes, throwing it into the audience. (It'll just disappear completely)
[*] She'll do the Pole Dance again, but this time without clothes.
[*] She'll walk out to the dressing room, completely nude.
[/olist]
We decided to start with the Pole Dance animation itself, as it's the hardest.
Now that it's done, step 4 of the script will automatically be done as well, since it's the same animation, being just a variation.

Some extra facts about this scene: Unlike the looping animations we usually do, this is an animation that goes from beginning to end once and then ends, which is what makes it so laborious, as it takes more unique frames for the animation to be better utilized.
On the other hand, the final result of the animation is superior, as it presents new movements from beginning to end and, in our opinion, this increases the quality of the animation, as there's always the novelty factor when watching it for the first time.
We also decided to include the backwards version in it, as we realized that this creates an interesting result, so we can increase the duration of the animation and make it loopable, even though we only plan to play it once.

The Julia Pole Dance Scene is not complete yet, as we still have the animations of Julia entering and exiting the catwalk to do, but these animations are extremely easier to do than the pole dance one, so it won't be long until they are done and we can consider this scene finished.
We'll probably bring the conclusion of this scene, along with the missing animations, in the next post.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
We know you like to have regular news on the project's development, but there is a reason why we decided to postpone publishing news.
As you can see, most of the progress we've made is related to dialogue between characters or progress in gameplay-related parts.
Although they're also important parts of the game and add to the final product, they don't have the same appeal to the audience as the sex scenes.
For this reason, we decided to wait to accumulate more content and complete at least one erotic scene before posting news here, as we understand that news that only contained dialogue between characters would not be fun.

We apologize for the inconvenience to those eagerly awaiting the next update, and we understand your desire to play and see the content that will arrive in the next version.
We appreciate your interest in following our work and eagerly awaiting each update, because without it, we would have no reason to continue working on the development of this project.
Despite the setbacks, we assure you that we're continuing to actively work on this project and we're really excited to release the next update.

We've never been closer to the release of episode 4, with just one sex scene left to do after we finish the current one, so it's time to get hyped!
We hope you're enjoying what you're seeing in the previews so far.
Cheers! 🍻

tags.feature: Starting in Episode 4, the player will be able to access other parts of the city by exiting through the bar's entrance door, the one where you hang the sign in Episode 1.
At first, the only accessible place will be the gym, but in the future, a menu will be added that will allow access to new locations in the city that appear as the story progresses.
This news highlight surely is the preview video attached to this topic, which shows the final result of this animation.
This animation will also have a nude variant that will be part of the same scene.

We created a script for what will happen during this scene:
[*] She'll walk down the catwalk wearing the bikini.
[*] She'll do the Pole Dance wearing the bikini.
[*] There'll be a pause and she'll take off her clothes, throwing it into the audience. (It'll just disappear completely)
[*] She'll do the Pole Dance again, but this time without clothes.
[*] She'll walk out to the dressing room, completely nude.
We decided to start with the Pole Dance animation itself, as it's the hardest.
Now that it's done, step 4 of the script will automatically be done as well, since it's the same animation, being just a variation.

Unlike the looping animations we usually do, this is an animation that goes from beginning to end once and then ends, which is what makes it so laborious, as it takes more unique frames for the animation to be better utilized.

On the other hand, the final result of the animation is superior, as it presents new movements from beginning to end and, in our opinion, this increases the quality of the animation, as there's always the novelty factor when watching it for the first time.

We also decided to include the backwards version in it, as we realized that this creates an interesting result, so we can increase the duration of the animation and make it loopable, even though we only plan to play it once.

The Julia Pole Dance Scene is not complete yet, as we still have the animations of Julia entering and exiting the catwalk to do, but these animations are extremely easier to do than the pole dance one, so it won't be long until they are done and we can consider this scene finished.

notes.title: Progress Report - May 2024
notes.content:
What's up, guys!
Today we came to bring you a little more of our progress in developing the game.
Today's content is varied, so let's separate it into parts.

[h2]A little more development progress[/h2]
After finishing Beatrice's sex scene, we had some development progress.

[h3]Dialogue between Beatrice and the MC[/h3]
There was another section of dialogue between Beatrice and the MC in which she gave him the task of the day, in addition to paying his salary.

This dialogue is the final part of the preface for the 5th day, and is already completely done.
You can see some renders that make up this scene below, including some images of the MC being paid and some facial expressions of him and Beatrice.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/c737790fee98dbe83e22f3e8cf09612fbb360b9b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/32ac45a5c408960b5760d6980d6a1c4eb2fa17a6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/ef3729bdc9a159f1d5531762f94ed2a6a9b74876.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/11800e1d80341a02be8a8aaf86eb07aa53293fb0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/5e5d39c7f53b782cb3bf45d0268389648a3892d2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/795ae7371cb93b5201dc033e08555c3b95902f0d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a39be8dd90e1b768b0a4c08b614376e32b68ee4c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/f9ec12c5b3c40c15e3e3401f9a664084eb5230df.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/42452929cd50d37f35f9f98ec532683ddfc914f7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/cb23fa6a9dc3db23103e4199bcb02fc3f87d669e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/c815ca6280440bbfb54b6583887a8b82723bcbb3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/9fc8a4972e4ee69913adcc4fbf0016506beea44d.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Dialogue between Sakura and the MC[/h3]
After the conversation with Beatrice, you'll enter Exploration Mode and effectively begin Day 5.

As soon as you leave Beatrice's Room door, going into the hallway, you'll automatically enter a scene, where Sakura will be waiting for you to talk to you.

This dialogue shows you another goal that must be achieved during Day 5, but this time it's a task that Sakura will give you, instead of Beatrice, as is usual.
Furthermore, this conversation with Sakura will also reveal some secrets about the plot that takes place on Day 5.
We prefer not to tell you this part so as not to spoil the surprise.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8256c6ee8596f74e78e1dcdd807e9943fc097615.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/2667f64e400676691cad54ef265e0fcfb185c881.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/68a06b7c85b9b57bb2742675374b1f22a691a4b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e13c3be151bd80257e34762d9612ce70b022205f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/5caca02b4ba1cc4ffc78d3e59c925da849143f4f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e833b7026ebee862c4d551d063bc6fb7825db17a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/0f5334a30c46295105750836bdb420e6cdfafb5b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/3dd4e7c5799109754de9a3ee920507547a5d2dbc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/15323fee7e40e9eb41dd81d70911c8a90cc8c475.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4e8fc89aea22c18bb0ad73ab1b8cfceaf2ac11a9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/cae9ca952d02f23a62729ca887d61405dc2dab0e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/b7ebee3f3b4874b555087761341aade46e6cf148.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/13a0b49ca9283fd8497acb075bb122eb28bf5fa3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/87ef5c924e0433bd6d3a707f7a3cbf6e6bee76df.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/541bf674b97ec85014cadab895a749993d8c3547.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/f0b0549b9945996b3c6f555b1fb77f6d331f2b10.png[/img][/url]

[h3]New Achievement - 100[/h3]
The game now has a new achievement to be unlocked in its arsenal.

We finally reached the 100th gallery image and, to celebrate, we created a special render for it.
We've included this special render in the game as an unlockable and also an achievement to go along with it.

When you unlock the 100th gallery image, the achievement 100 will be unlocked, along with this special render in the gallery.

Thus, we record our mark forever in the game itself.

As expected, this achievement will be available in all versions, whether on Steam or other platforms.

In the first 2 images below, you can see the new achievement unlocked in the achievements menu and the image that is unlocked in the gallery when reaching a total of 100 gallery images.
In the 3rd image, we can see what this new gallery image looks like.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8df6a9fbc1605f30b95f094f6fc3ab345ab2081f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8820061f1c56b01cd8fc01d41ca85efcdb17884f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/1202bcbe82a5fa4050febf5c3146bf8dfc772123.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a669fe230f10f6e781e12cb7165fe82a54dadfe7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/5dfc62673d756b55994295e1c09791a9d09718e8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e17c10d07300488bd7c582a40a2e1860155b5268.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Exploration Mode sections completed[/h2]
Once these dialogues are over, we finally have Free Roaming (or Exploration Mode) again.

All sections of Exploration Mode have been completed.

There are some variety of different things throughout the maps that we had to complete before declaring this part done, so let's go by topic.

[h3]Beatrice Room[/h3]
In this room, there were changes resulting from the dialogue with Beatrice that the MC just had. 
Beatrice is sitting in a different location on the bed and the porn movie that was playing during the sex scene with her is being shown on the TV, as this is part of the context of the game during day 5.

In image 1, we have the "Front View" and, in image 2, we have the "Rear View".

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/497aac7640348eb856115eb248ca29e471094011.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/cd203860f29b78ae6dd2bb2fac21b255037dc854.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/aa1e2fa5de75bc9f2030be82becfe01cf91bf3e6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/973228694c459d5a3d24a0abf6495c3f306e7030.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Sakura's Room[/h3]
We see small changes here, such as the presence of high heels and the basket of clothes that Sakura usually carries around.

Sakura is also sitting on the bed, wearing her usual maid clothes.
She's waiting for you to bring her the items she asked you to get.
Once you complete this task, you'll unlock extra content.

In image 1, you can see what Sakura's room looked like on day 5 and, in image 2, you see an image of when you interact with Sakura in her room.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/1361ed782b8db6c80fd4f851d8da2d6f27ddcc14.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/c7355e5a2c806f1d835a43a8b59d659f19230051.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/df67ff32921f9b68ee8833cda71ed0c0b39cddba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/d215beaa70b700a3db202b0dc56a7d54059928bd.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Item Shop[/h3]
2 new items are available to be purchased in the Item Shop during the 5th day: TV Remote and Batteries.
You'll need to deliver these items to Sakura to complete a task, this'll unlock extra content.
These items were also added as conditions for obtaining the Delivery Man achievement.

In images 1, 2 and 3, you can see the items displayed on the Item Shop shelf with their respective descriptions.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/366d789cbb7144aa5c26456fd65344048ed7ec6f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e6d29efaf4889694fdb4d8d8e2d65d45d7a58389.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/02b3ec1cec0c1fb1cf3c77dca5b2ee57913d57f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a828df77efb092e85dccc423bc65deac1aa7f762.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/8e9dab6da6553dda0d6eab3b866a82bdf0f3da62.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e06f2cff7bafb0a110998f355ba5ff42c99a9677.png[/img][/url]

In images 4 and 5, you can see the 2 new items in the Inventory, along with their descriptions.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/a7dce420ae8e3b7d7ab1c42be85b34972cfd9232.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/1e582ba41c5176c7bdf4b341fdf5f74a60b41e9d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/1bc6b8028d054d1da9616ec4b23be2433bc39211.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/19051a0232acb39d1e7116d461991f7b338e59d5.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Sex Shop[/h3]
Some places required only small changes to have the 5th day part done.
One of these places was the Sex Shop.
Here, there was only a change in the main character's clothes during the dialogues with the shopkeeper.
You can see an example in this image.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/4af675e940f957d98734d758b71144b5a8ec7a28.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43849877/e79a1c08146732fae7e13393cc47c3683a82df12.png[/img][/url]

[h3]All remaining sections[/h3]
There are still other sections of Exploration Mode that are done, although we have not included preview images of them, they are:
[list]
[*] Luna Room
[*] Veronika Room
[*] MC Room
[*] Photo Studio
[*] Bar (All sections)
[/list]
[h3]There were also small changes to the code, not visible, for better optimization[/h3]
With the changes we made, the renders that change according to the day of the game will be automatically implemented, simply by adding the image to the game folder.

This should speed up the release of the next updates, as it eliminates the need to modify the game's code in the future.

[b]============//============[/b]
We know that as these updates only concern gameplay aspects, such as dialogue between characters, the maps that can be explored in Exploration Mode, new features (new items, new achievement) and code optimization, may not be as interesting to follow. But the good news is that, as we have concluded this part, we'll be able to move on to the development of the sex scenes, so expect news in this regard soon.

That's all for today,
Cheers! 🍻
